decisions.response_type: Address concerns by adjusting facilitation style
decisions.finding: Morgan's corrections during planning discussions are perceived as abrupt and create handoff difficulties.

commitments.detail: Adjust corrections to be more gentle and considerate of team dynamics.
Ravi will take over facilitation duties starting next week.
Meetings will end at 17:00 to ensure smoother handoffs.
Document the new facilitation plan and any other collaboration safeguards in the case file.
